name: keycade
description: A shortcut recall arcade for Omarchy, herdr, tmux, Vim, Neovim and LazyVim — six cabinets, each with its own deck, progress and mastery.
description_good_justification: Keycade is an arcade-style shortcut recall training platform designed for Omarchy and modern Wayland desktops. See https://github.com/luneth90/keycade#readme
interact_justification: Installation instructions are in https://github.com/luneth90/keycade#readme, feedback and issues at https://github.com/luneth90/keycade/issues, and contribution guide at https://github.com/luneth90/keycade/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: The software is released under the MIT License, which is a recognized Free/Libre and Open Source Software (FLOSS) license. See https://github.com/luneth90/keycade/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT License is explicitly approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI): https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT
documentation_interface_justification: The README and manifest document the plugin interface, training grounds, and Wayland input protocols: https://github.com/luneth90/keycade#readme
repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
release_notes_justification: Non-trivial release notes file in repository: <https://github.com/luneth90/keycade/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md>.
report_process_justification: Non-trivial SECURITY[.md] file found file in repository: <https://github.com/luneth90/keycade/blob/main/SECURITY.md>. [osps_do_02_01]
discussion_justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.
english_justification: All core documentation (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md) and commit messages are in English. GitHub issues and pull requests are accepted in English.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained with frequent commits, official release (v1.0.0), automated CI/CD, and weekly Dependabot dependency updates: https://github.com/luneth90/keycade/commits/main
project_entry_attribution: Please credit Luneth90 and the CII Best Practices badge contributors.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities or CVEs have affected this project.
report_responses_justification: Maintainer acknowledges and addresses issues on GitHub.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are triaged on GitHub issues.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: Initial response within 48 hours as documented in SECURITY.md
build_justification: Interpreted Python and Qt6 QML application; no compilation build step required.
test_most_justification: 74% line coverage with 188 Python tests and 92 QML tests.
test_policy_justification: Policy documented in CONTRIBUTING.md requiring automated tests for new features.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent commits and PRs include extensive unit and QML tests.
warnings_justification: qmllint and CodeQL security checks enforced in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: All linter warnings and CodeQL alerts are resolved (0 alerts).
warnings_strict_justification: CI fails on syntax or lint errors.
know_secure_design_justification: Maintainer adheres to defense-in-depth and security invariants R1–R8 and L1.
know_common_errors_justification: Codebase prevents prototype pollution, injection, and path traversal.
crypto_published_justification: Software does not implement or use custom cryptography.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Software does not store passwords or authenticate users.
crypto_random_justification: No cryptographic keys or nonces generated.
delivery_unsigned_justification: All delivery channels use HTTPS TLS encryption through GitHub.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Rapid patch policy documented in SECURITY.md.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL static analysis runs on every push and PR: https://github.com/luneth90/keycade/actions/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-and-quality suite detects common vulnerabilities.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: All static analysis findings are resolved (0 alerts).
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every commit and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Automated tests actively execute dynamic paths and runtime assertions in CI.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Software is written in memory-safe languages: Python and QML/JavaScript.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Runtime invariant assertions (R1–R8, L1) are actively verified during tests.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Any dynamic issues identified are resolved before merging.
